plan-format.md requires a '## Lean Challenge Statements' block whose identifier set equals Goals, and lean-plan-compliance-check.sh then requires every named identifier to be PRESENT at final verification. A decision-gate plan whose later phases may legitimately close [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] cannot satisfy that must-exist semantics, and 'refutation' polarity is equally wrong. Resolved by declaring an explicit non-refutation Goal Polarity so the spot-check records 'skipped' with a stated reason, which is the documented mixed-polarity escape; there is no 'conditional' polarity value in the vocabulary.
